entries.title: A panel you asked for ends with a note about it
entries.body: When a crewmate finishes building or changing one of your panels, it shows what it built on a note, and the first mate closes the task once the panel is saved. Closing the note tells the app you have seen it.
entries.noPicture: The note is an ordinary card; what changed is how the build's task ends, which a still picture does not show.
